parts.text: A student determines the resistance of a resistance wire. She uses the circuit shown in Fig. 2.1.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) She measures the current I in the circuit. Write down the current reading shown in Fig. 2.2. I = ......................................................... [2]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) She places the sliding contact C at a distance l = 20.0 cm from P . She records the potential difference V across the length l of the resistance wire. She repeats the procedure using l values of 40.0 cm, 60.0 cm, 80.0 cm and 100.0 cm. The readings are shown in Table 2.1. Table 2.1 l / cm V / R / 20.0 0.60 40.0 1.10 1.96 60.0 1.71 3.05 80.0 2.30 4.11 100.0 2.78 4.96

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Calculate, and record in Table 2.1, the resistance R of 20.0 cm of the resistance wire. Use the equation R = V I . [2]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Complete the column headings in Table 2.1. [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Look carefully at the values of l and R in Table 2.1.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Tick one box to show your conclusion from the results. R is constant within the limits of experimental accuracy. R is directly proportional to l within the limits of experimental accuracy. R decreases as l increases. There is no simple relationship between R and l . [1]

ms.label: 2(c)(ii)
ms.text: justification – only award if the 2nd box is ticked

parts.label: i
parts.text: (d) (i) Use the values in Table 2.1 to estimate the potential difference V e across 50.0 cm of the resistance wire. V e = ......................................................... [1]

ms.label: 2(d)(i)
ms.text: value approximately halfway between the 40 cm and 60 cm values

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the resistance of 50.0 cm of the resistance wire using the equation R = V e I . Use the value of current I from part (a) . Give your answer to a suitable number of significant figures for this experiment and include the unit. R = ......................................................... [2]

ms.label: 2(d)(ii)
ms.text:
correct R value from candidate’s value in (d)(i)
2 or 3 significant figures

ms.label: 2(e)
ms.text: use a low(er) current / voltage / switch off between readings / add a resistor in series / use a thinner wire
